The '''Imperial Valorous Services Medal''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] medal awarded to individuals who conducted perilous operations for the Empire with success and displayed exceptional bravery in the face of danger.<ref name="SWG:IVSM" />

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> one such medal was awarded to a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] alongside several Imperial supporters who had [[Mission to rescue Doctor Bledsoe|rescued]] [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Bledsoe]] from captivity during the assault of a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[CR90 corvette/Legends|Corellian corvette]].<ref name="SWG:CC">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=heroic|Corellian Corvette}}</ref>

The Rebel Alliance had a similar award named [[Alliance Valorous Services Medal]].<ref name="SWG:AVSM">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=collection|Alliance Valorous Services Medal}}</ref>
